div.head: Wl art 3.2
div.ab: Ubi vero substantia domini defecerit, totus hundredus in quo occisio facta est, communiter persolvat quod remanet.
When, however, the property of the lord fails, the whole hundred in which the murder was committed shall pay in common what remains.
div.note: Added October 2026 from Robertson pp. 238–239 (text and translation); Liebermann’s text (K–M) not yet added
